author: Antonio Clim
stage: local-candidate; exact remote CI belongs to the phase audit, not this pre-CI snapshot

findings.problem: Mixed fence delimiters were accepted as Markdown closers
findings.remedy: Require a homogeneous closer matching the opening delimiter character and minimum length.

findings.problem: Evidence and entity ownership were incompletely bound
findings.remedy: Bind path, coordinates, specification entity kind, singleton entity identity and evidence scope. Three additional targeted substitutions are retained separately.

findings.problem: Record identifiers were format-checked but not recomputed
findings.remedy: Recompute the identifier from specification, entity and evidence identifiers.

findings.problem: Numeric codomains admitted invalid scalar types and ranges
findings.evidence: adv-negative-count; adv-fractional-count; adv-boolean-count; adv-string-count; adv-bytes-count; adv-complex-count
findings.remedy: Enforce all forty existing codomains, units and scales; explicitly exclude Boolean counts and non-JSON scalars.

findings.problem: The S01 adapter accepted invalid input records
findings.remedy: Validate the kernel record before adapting it.

findings.problem: Recoverable resource errors escaped the measurement boundary
findings.remedy: Return typed ME-015 refusal by raising MeasurementError. No partial result, zero substitution or universal containment claim.

findings.problem: ME-008 has conflicting historical descriptions in the kernel and error register
findings.remedy: Retain the locked unsupported-language ME-008 test; separate the two meanings explicitly in the additive error extension. Do not silently repurpose the code.

findings.problem: Contract version 1.1.0 does not uniquely identify implementation bytes
findings.remedy: No version change is authorised. Exact Git commit and source SHA-256 remain mandatory build identities; S04 must separate build identity from specification version in downstream interpretation.

deviations.description: An earlier S03 hash-only commitment was found at 7fceee8042f18fc6110ebc2dd6dc9d504e9f8683. Its protocol bytes and any subsequent local outcomes were not recovered. The full resumption protocol was persisted at ef45fe8d20fe74a0e888e8dae4e6fe374c659aee before measurements in this resumed execution. This is not the original protocol, an external preregistration or uninterrupted prospective history.

The first execution was stopped by the tool at its 200-second boundary. Its truncated raw output is retained; a repeat added incremental negative journals and progress checkpoints. This interruption is not classified as a product timeout.

Corrective regression tests, positive/negative oracle controls and three previously named runtime-grammar frontier checks were operationalised after baseline observation. They are supplementary, not new confirmatory hypotheses. The eight hypotheses, corpus input bytes, estimands and tolerances were not changed. Resource-worker successful results were subsequently retained in full and checked for byte counts, grammar-specific missingness and analytic literal counts; original baseline counts are not rewritten.

An initial supplementary H04 negative control mutated the first record, a Markdown record deliberately excluded by H04. Its assertion failed. The control was corrected to mutate python.function_definition_count. The initial source and failing test log are preserved; no production outcome was reclassified.

Three additional entity-kind, singleton-identity and evidence-scope substitutions were tested after the first correction. All were accepted by S02 and the first correction, then rejected by the final correction. Their pre-repair results and regression tests are retained separately from the original 2000-case/41-probe matrix.

deviations.scope: post-baseline corrective fault-injection and CI evidence export
deviations.description: A pre-persistence fault-injection probe found that the new scope binding rejected the pre-existing ME-013 unavailable-callable-span fallback. The failure was retained separately and the exception narrowed to physical_span_lines/unavailable/ME-013 with whole-artifact evidence. One corrective regression was added, increasing corrective unit tests from 18 to 19. This is not part of the original 197 baseline failed checks. Portable cell summaries were also added to CI job logs; raw artefacts remain separately uploaded.

scope_limits: No participant study, construct validation, educational utility, fairness or authorship detection
The finite token-spacing formatter is not Black, Ruff or a universal formatter
The generated grammar is not factorial: async selection is coupled to family parity
Independent traversal shares the CPython AST front-end; analytic counts are a separate finite oracle
Schema/identity validation checks internal consistency, not authentic measurement or signed attestation
Core equality is assessed separately from runtime grammar frontiers and OS-specific limits
